## Runspur v0.1.0

The first Windows x64 backend preview: project-scoped asynchronous delegation with MCP tools, durable task execution, and active result delivery.

### Install

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmacemace/runspur/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

No Rust or Node.js installation is required. The installer verifies the release archive, installs the three programs into the current user's application directory, and adds them to the user PATH.

### Included

- `schedulerd.exe`: per-user background scheduler.
- `schedulerctl.exe`: project configuration, integration, inspection, and cancellation.
- `scheduler-mcp.exe`: project-level MCP stdio bridge.
- Project Skill/MCP integration, per-call origin resolution, task isolation, and idempotent submission.
- Windows named pipes, protected credentials, Job Object supervision, cancellation, deadlines, and crash recovery.
- Transactional result outbox and experimental delivery to the original Codex desktop conversation.
- MIT license and third-party license notices.

### Validation and scope

The Rust workspace has 32 automated tests. Release packages additionally undergo installation, upgrade/rollback, archive validation, and installed-program tests.

The live desktop smoke executed the deterministic Probe worker and verified persisted tool-output identity in the original conversation. Successful real Codex/Claude model worker tasks and real parent consumption acknowledgments still need validation. Desktop delivery is pinned to the verified distribution described in the README.

This release has no GUI. macOS/Linux backends, Claude parent inbox delivery, code-writing/worktree/merge workflows, and startup registration are not implemented.

### Assets

- `runspur-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.zip`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `install.ps1`

See the [README](https://github.com/ohmacemace/runspur#readme) for setup and compatibility details.
